app.name: notebooklm-py
app.one_liner: An unofficial Python API and CLI for Google NotebookLM that enables programmatic access to features beyond the web UI, including AI agent integration, research automation, and content generation.

screens.name: Notebook Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display active notebook, sources, and generated artifacts with options to trigger new actions like research, generation, or export.

rust_commands.name: auth_refresh
rust_commands.purpose: Trigger a one-shot session keepalive to rotate authentication cookies and persist them to storage.

rust_commands.name: doctor
rust_commands.purpose: Run diagnostics on authentication, profile setup, and migration status with optional auto-fix.

rust_commands.name: note_create
rust_commands.purpose: Create a new note in the current notebook with specified content and metadata.

rust_commands.name: profile_switch
rust_commands.purpose: Switch the active Google account profile for subsequent commands.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add basic notebook and source CRUD operations
week 1: Expose CLI commands for note creation and metadata export
week 1: Implement core NotebookLMClient with auth and cookie persistence
acceptance_tests: Auth refresh command successfully rotates SIDTS cookies and persists updated state
CLI-created notes should appear in the web UI with interactive [N] citation hover links
Conversations initiated via CLI must be visible in the NotebookLM web interface
Profile switching correctly isolates storage and credentials across Google accounts
